chats.answer:
The best trolling motor battery box depends on your battery size, whether you're using lithium (LiFePO4) or lead-acid, and whether you need built-in circuit protection and USB charging.

For most 12V trolling motor setups, I'd prioritize a box with a 50A–60A circuit breaker, heavy-duty terminals, water-resistant construction, and enough space for a Group 27 or Group 31 battery.

Here are the options I'd consider.

Top 3 trolling motor battery boxes
Best overall

Newport Smart Battery Box

$69.99

60A breaker, external terminals, USB and 12V outlet, battery indicator. Excellent for portable 12V trolling motor setups.

4.8/5 · 305 reviews at Newport

Shop at Newport

Best budget

NOCO BG31 Snap-Top Battery Box

$12.88

Fits Group 24–31 batteries, sturdy enclosure and ventilated design. No built-in breaker or power ports; add appropriate protection separately.

4.7/5 · 39 reviews at Walmart

Shop at Walmart

Legacy alternative

Minn Kota Trolling Motor Power Center

$99.98

Built-in 60A breaker, battery meter and external terminals. Fits Group 24/27 batteries. Minn Kota confirms this model is no longer manufactured, though remaining stock is listed. 
Minn Kota

View remaining stock

Important: A built-in 60A breaker isn't automatically correct for every motor. Match the breaker to your motor manufacturer's specifications. Also, the Newport battery-level indicator is not accurate for lithium batteries. 
Minn Kota
+1

Which one should you buy?

For a kayak or small fishing boat using a single 12V battery, I'd choose the Newport Smart Battery Box. For a larger Group 31 battery or a simple, inexpensive enclosure, I'd choose the NOCO BG31.
